project.name: Tracebound — Provenance Research Without Inventing History
project.summary: An evidence-bound WebMCP workbench where agents map provenance without manufacturing certainty.
project.ai_usage: A browser agent uses page-hosted WebMCP tools to organize evidence; the running app uses deterministic rules and no model API.
project.codex_usage: OpenAI Codex assisted with requirements research, WebMCP implementation, tests, interface code, and submission drafting.
